description:
FILED s471 (Fable, 2026-09-06) from the USER's question 3; design = docs/plan-cache-and-install-s471.md section 3 (a)-(g) -- read it first.  The install ALREADY has perl's shape (bin/ wrappers exec <prefix>/lib/pcl/<cmd>; the tree keeps its repo-relative layout; the core at <prefix>/lib/pcl/pcl.core); this task closes the gaps, it does not change the model.

(a) tools/install-pcl installs pcl (@TREE + wrapper) and the smoke test runs the INSTALLED pcl too.
(b) PCLPaths::root(): $PCL_ROOT when set, else derived from the caller's real path, VERIFIED by cl/pcl-runtime.lisp existing there, die naming both candidates otherwise.  Callers: pcl, pl2cl, runpcl, tools/sweep-perl-tests.pl (after #1301), tools/pclperl-for-tests, tools/runt, tools/clt, PCLSbcl::_installed_core.  Five spellings become one (F5 in the plan).
(c) PATH: print the exact export line only when $bindir is not on PATH; never edit rc files.
(d) --uninstall: remove <prefix>/lib/pcl + the wrappers; say the per-user cache is untouched.
(e) needs #1303 (a root-built core must not bake /root into every user's cache dir) -- verify with a fresh-HOME install + run.
(f) installed set = pcl, pl2cl, runpcl, tools/lib; never the dev runners.

BARS: tools/t/install-pcl.t extended (pcl installed + runs; --uninstall; PCL_ROOT override; the PATH hint's two branches); the install-matrix workflow still green; gate; no-hardcoded-paths-01.t.  After BY (#1300).

=== TESTS (USER ask 2026-09-06; plan doc section 5.2, Layer A) ===
Extend tools/t/install-pcl.t: ONE real install WITH the core reused by every row (the --no-core install stays for the fast rows; the file is not in the gate, ~1 min is fine).  Rows: (1) <prefix>/lib/pcl/pcl.core exists and PCL_SHOW_SBCL=1 <prefix>/bin/runpcl names it; (2) the installed pcl -e runs; (3) the same program from another cwd and through a SYMLINKED bin dir; (4) HOME=<tmp> -> <tmp>/.pcl-cache is created and nothing under the dev home is touched; PCL_CACHE_DIR=<tmp2> -> the module .lisp/.fasl land under <tmp2> (FAILS today = #1303: the installed core was built under the dev HOME, so this row is the built-by-A-run-under-B case without a second user); (5) --force replaces the tree and a vanished shim does not survive; (6) --uninstall leaves the cache untouched; (7) the PATH hint printed only when $bindir is not on PATH; (8) PCL_ROOT at a dir without cl/pcl-runtime.lisp dies naming both candidates, at the install root works.  Inverse-verify rows 4 and 8 on a git-archive extraction of main.  Layer B (the container test) is #1304 -- same agent if a runtime is present by then.

=== DONE (s470bz) ===
Shipped in two commits on main b5e9f845.

(b) ONE ROOT RESOLVER.  PCLPaths::root($hint) -- $PCL_ROOT when set (explicit
always wins; an unusable one DIES naming both candidates rather than falling
back silently), else the caller's own real directory and then its PARENT,
exactly two candidates because PCL ships scripts at two depths, each VERIFIED
by cl/pcl-runtime.lisp being there, and a die naming everything tried (rule
12).  PCLPaths::root_of($path) is the same derivation WITHOUT the env override
-- the question PCLSbcl::_installed_core asks ("which tree owns this runtime
file"), where undef is a real answer (a checkout has no pcl.core).
Callers switched: pcl, pl2cl, runpcl, tools/sweep-perl-tests.pl,
tools/pclperl-for-tests, tools/runt, tools/clt, PCLSbcl::_installed_core (the
regex is gone), plus tools/install-pcl itself via root_of.

THE BOOTSTRAP is documented and asserted rather than removed: a script cannot
call root() before it has found tools/lib, so one `use lib` per script stays.
Pl/t/pcl-root-01.t (28 rows, 230 ms) writes out each caller's OLD spelling and
demands it equal root()'s answer, then runs all seven scripts under a $PCL_ROOT
that is not a PCL tree and demands the resolver's own message -- a caller still
deriving its own root would carry on and pass.

FOUND AND FIXED BY THE GATE: pl2cl cannot `use lib "<root>/tools/lib"` (its
@INC is EMITTED into every program preamble as *p-core-inc-dirs*), and the
first attempt loaded PCLPaths BY ABSOLUTE PATH, which keys %INC on the path;
the sibling `require PCLPaths` in Pl/ProtoCache.pm and PCLSbcl.pm then read the
file a second time and redefined every sub -- ten warnings on the stderr of
EVERY transpile, five gate files failing on the noise (cache-surface-01,
feature-pragma-01, fileio-02, module-fasl-cache-01, pcl-dash-m-01).  Fixed with
`local @INC` + `require PCLPaths`, the shape ProtoCache::cache_dir already used.

(a) `pcl` is installed (tree + wrapper) and the smoke test runs the INSTALLED
`pcl <file>` AND `pcl -e`.  @COMMANDS is ONE list read by the tree copy, the
wrapper loop, the smoke test and --uninstall.
(c) The PATH hint prints the exact `export PATH="<bindir>:$PATH"` line, only
when <bindir> is not on $PATH, and edits no rc file.
(d) --uninstall [--prefix DIR] removes <prefix>/lib/pcl and exactly the
wrappers this script wrote (recognised by CONTENT -- a foreign `pcl` in that
bin directory is left alone and said to be); refuses naming the directory when
there is no PCL install (rule 12); asks for NO dependencies; says the per-user
cache is untouched and names `pcl --clear-cache`.
(e) Proven by rows, no code: a core built under one HOME serves a run under
another, whose module cache lands under the RUNNING home, and nothing under the
install prefix is written at run time.
(f) The installed set is pcl pl2cl runpcl + Pl/ lib/ cl/ tools/lib/; a row
asserts tools/runt, tools/clt, tools/sweep-perl-tests.pl, tools/install-pcl and
Pl/t are NOT there.
(g) write_version_file gains a second source: `git describe --tags`, else
CHANGELOG.md's top heading (what a tarball or a git-archive extraction has),
else "unknown" plainly; the answer says which source it came from.  ONE writer,
ONE reader (pcl's pcl_version, unchanged).
--help documents --uninstall, PCL_ROOT and PCL_CACHE_DIR.

LAYER A: tools/t/install-pcl.t 15 -> 57 rows, 21.7 s, still not in the gate.  A
SECOND install WITH the core, built once and reused: (1) the core exists and
PCL_SHOW_SBCL shows the installed runpcl spawning with exactly it; (2) the
installed pcl runs a script and inline code; (3) another cwd + a SYMLINKED bin
dir; (4) a fresh HOME gets its own cache, a second home too without disturbing
the first, PCL_CACHE_DIR puts the module .lisp where it says, and nothing under
the prefix is written at run time (two SYNTHETIC homes, not the developer's:
the real one is shared with whatever else runs on this box, so a count of it is
not evidence); (5) --force replaces and a vanished shim does not survive, while
a second install without --force refuses and changes nothing; (6) --uninstall
removes the tree and the wrappers, leaves a foreign file, leaves the cache byte
for byte, refuses the second time; (7) the PATH hint in both branches, naming
no rc file; (8) PCL_ROOT bogus dies naming both candidates, PCL_ROOT at the
install root works.  Inverse: 23 of the 57 fail on a `git archive b5e9f845`
extraction, including the whole of row 4's family (25-28, 31-32) and row 8's
(37-40).

BARS: gate 218 files / 7569 tests, only the 13 standing pclxs xs rows;
corpus-diff b5e9f845 IDENTICAL over 111, silent drops 5 (run twice); no
generation bump.  PCL_SHOW_SBCL byte-identical vs the extraction for runpcl and
for the sweep, on the cached-core AND the PCL_NO_CORE leg, normalising only the
tree root, the core's PATHKEY (= sha1 of the abs runtime path) and per-run temp
names.  RUNNERS row: full sweep --jobs 4 GATE clean, TOTAL passing 18674 (+0),
0 new / 0 fixed, drops 5 = census, shortfall 12213 (+0), CAUSES 0 -- and the
run's .faillog/_status.tsv is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the OLD runner's on the
extraction (108 files, no column differs).  Companion: run-perl-suite.pl
--jobs 1 op/time.t PCL_SHOW_SBCL identical before/after after normalising the
two per-run fields, with a control run of the same runner on the same tree
showing it varies both by itself.

FILED: #1325 (PCLProc.pm:58 prints two warning lines on every sweep's stderr),
#1326 (three more root derivations in Pl/ProtoCache.pm behind one bootstrap),
#1327 (a saved core memoises the BUILDER's asdf:*user-cache*).
subject: BZ: the install layout (USER 2026-09-06): install pcl (today only pl2cl+runpcl); ONE root resolver PCLPaths::root() with $PCL_ROOT override; PATH line printed only when missing; --uninstall; installed-mode caches per user
